crossRefs.note: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.
The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer…
About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head.
He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion reserved was reserved for him. He came with the…
With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward…
After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in…
Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
The sons of Gad lived beside them, in the land of Bashan to Salecah:
So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria…

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

translations.web: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.
translations.bsb: Gad will be attacked by raiders, but he will attack their heels.
translations.kjv: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
translations.asv: Gad, a troop shall press upon him; But he shall press upon their heel.
